10k.note: On 2026-03-06 entered into Merger Agreement to be acquired by Kuva Labs Inc. for $5.00/share + CVR tied to certepetide NDA filing.

pipeline.target: Alpha-v beta-3 / alpha-v beta-5 integrins; neuropilin-1 (CendR active transport pathway)

indications.indication: Metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) — combination with gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel
indications.trial_design: Randomized (2:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b; two cohorts (single vs two-dose certepetide)
indications.lead_sponsor: Australasian Gastrointestinal Trials Group (AGITG) / University of Sydney; Lisata collaborator
key_milestones: Cohort A mOS 12.68 vs 9.72 mo (ASCO GI Jan-2025)

excluded_preclinical: HONEDRA / LSTA12 (CD34+ for CLI) — non-active per 10-K
OLOGO / LSTA14 (CD34+ for NORDA) — non-active per 10-K
excluded_legacy_terminated: BOLSTER cholangiocarcinoma trial — completed, no benefit
Certepetide Phase 1b/2a continuous infusion mPDAC (NCT06592664) — withdrawn
excluded_partner_owned: Investigator-initiated certepetide trials (iLSTA, CENDIFOX, GBM Phase 2a) — academic-sponsored
